fields.name: type
fields.description: Kind of record.

fields.name: vehicle
fields.description: Vehicle name.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the record, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Time of day, HH:MM (HH:MM:SS is also accepted). Applies to refuel rows only.

fields.name: odometer_km
fields.description: Odometer reading. Unit: km. Required on refuel rows.

fields.name: odometer_estimated
fields.description: Written by Glovebox: the expense odometer is the last known reading, not an entered one. Leave empty. Applies to expense rows only.

fields.name: fuel_l
fields.description: Fuel quantity. Unit: l. Give two of fuel_l, price_per_l and total; the third is derived. Applies to refuel rows only.

fields.name: price_per_l
fields.description: Price per litre. Unit: currency/l. Give two of fuel_l, price_per_l and total; the third is derived. Applies to refuel rows only.

fields.name: total
fields.description: Refuel total, or expense amount (greater than 0). Unit: currency. Refuel: give two of fuel_l, price_per_l and total. Expense: required.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code; must equal the app currency when given.

fields.name: full
fields.description: The tank was filled completely. Applies to refuel rows only.

fields.name: missed_previous
fields.description: A fill-up before this one was not recorded. Applies to refuel rows only.

fields.name: station
fields.description: Station name. Applies to refuel rows only.

fields.name: station_location
fields.description: Station location; with the name it identifies the station. Applies to refuel rows only.

fields.name: station_brand
fields.description: Station brand; used only when the station is created. Applies to refuel rows only.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Expense category. Applies to expense rows only.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short label of the expense. Applies to expense rows only. Required on expense rows.

fields.name: coverage_start
fields.description: First day the expense covers (insurance, registration), YYYY-MM-DD. Set both coverage_start and coverage_end, or neither. Applies to expense rows only.

fields.name: coverage_end
fields.description: Last day the expense covers, YYYY-MM-DD. Set both coverage_start and coverage_end, or neither. Applies to expense rows only.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free text.

fields.name: derived
fields.description: Written by Glovebox: which refuel figure was derived. Leave empty. Applies to refuel rows only.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Written by Glovebox: where the record came from. Leave empty.

fields.name: source_ref
fields.description: Written by Glovebox: the record's id in its source. Leave empty.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Vehicle name, as used in records.csv.

fields.name: make
fields.description: Manufacturer.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model.

fields.name: plate
fields.description: Registration plate.

fields.name: fuel_type
fields.description: Fuel type.

fields.name: initial_odometer_km
fields.description: Odometer when tracking started. Unit: km.

fields.name: archived
fields.description: The vehicle is archived.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free text.

fields.name: vin
fields.description: Vehicle identification number.

fields.name: model_year
fields.description: Year of manufacture or model year.

fields.name: engine
fields.description: Engine, free text.

fields.name: tyre_size
fields.description: Tyre size, free text.

fields.name: insurance_policy
fields.description: Insurance policy number.

fields.name: insurance_valid_until
fields.description: Last day the current insurance is valid, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: registration_valid_until
fields.description: Last day the current registration is valid, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Station name.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Station location.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Station brand.

fields.name: uid
fields.description: Unique id of the reminder; kept across backup and restore. Empty gives the reminder a new id.

fields.name: vehicle
fields.description: Vehicle name, as used in records.csv.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short label of the reminder.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Reminder category (the expense categories).

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: Day the reminder is due, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: lead_days
fields.description: Notify this many days before the due date, 0 to 365.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether the reminder is still open.

fields.name: done_date
fields.description: Day the reminder was marked done; only for done reminders.

fields.name: vehicle_field
fields.description: Written by Glovebox: the vehicle date this reminder follows. Leave empty.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free text.
